zg361_mg_project_career_hc_q_receipts_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_q121_projected
			var:zg361_mg_q121_owner = var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_owner
			var:zg361_mg_q121_subject = this
			var:zg361_mg_q121_cycle = var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle
			var:zg361_mg_q121_case = var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_case
			var:zg361_mg_q121_state = var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_state
			OR = {
				NOT = { var:zg361_mg_q121_route = var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_route }
				NOT = { var:zg361_mg_q121_value = var:zg361_ch_m121_value }
			}
		}
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 121 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_q121_projected
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_state
			OR = {
				var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle < var:zg361_mg_q121_cycle
				AND = {
					var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q121_cycle
					var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_case < var:zg361_mg_q121_case
				}
				AND = {
					var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q121_cycle
					var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_case = var:zg361_mg_q121_case
					var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_state < var:zg361_mg_q121_state
				}
				AND = {
					var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q121_cycle

		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_value value = var:zg361_ch_m127_value }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_present value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_route = 1 var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_route = 2 }
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_id
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_owner
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_subject
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_case
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_state
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_revision
				var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_owner = var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_owner
				var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_subject = this
				var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_cycle = var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_cycle
				var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_case = var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_case
				var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_state = var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_state
				var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_route = var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_route
			}

			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_id value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_id }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_owner value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_owner }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_subject value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_subject }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_cycle value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_cycle }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_case value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_case }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_state value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_state }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q127_authoritative_object_revision value = var:zg361_ch_m127_manager_object_revision }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_q128_projected
			var:zg361_mg_q128_owner = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner
			var:zg361_mg_q128_subject = this
			var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle
			var:zg361_mg_q128_case = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case
			var:zg361_mg_q128_state = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state
			OR = {
				NOT = { var:zg361_mg_q128_route = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route }
				NOT = { var:zg361_mg_q128_value = var:zg361_ch_m128_value }
			}
		}
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 128 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_q128_projected
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state
			OR = {
				var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle < var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
				AND = {
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case < var:zg361_mg_q128_case
				}
				AND = {
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case = var:zg361_mg_q128_case
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state < var:zg361_mg_q128_state
				}
				AND = {
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case = var:zg361_mg_q128_case
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state = var:zg361_mg_q128_state
					NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner = var:zg361_mg_q128_owner }
				}
			}
		}
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 128 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_consumed
			var:zg361_ch_m128_consumed = 1
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_business_consumed
			var:zg361_ch_m128_business_consumed = 1
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route
			has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_value
			var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_subject = this
			var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state = 4
			OR = {
				AND = { var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route = 1 var:zg361_ch_m128_value = 1 }
				AND = { var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route = 2 var:zg361_ch_m128_value = -1 }
				AND = { var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route = 3 var:zg361_ch_m128_value = 0 }
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_mg_q128_projected }
				OR = {
					var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle > var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
					AND = {
						var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
						var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case > var:zg361_mg_q128_case
					}
					AND = {
						var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_mg_q128_cycle
						var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case = var:zg361_mg_q128_case
						var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state > var:zg361_mg_q128_state
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_projected value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_source value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_owner value = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_cycle value = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_case value = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_state value = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_route value = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_value value = var:zg361_ch_m128_value }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_authoritative_object_present value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route = 1 var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route = 2 }
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_id
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_owner
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_subject
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_case
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_state
				has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_revision
				var:zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_owner = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner
				var:zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_subject = this
				var:zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_cycle = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle
				var:zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_case = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case
				var:zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_state = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state
				var:zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_route = var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_q128_authoritative_object_present value = 1 }

zg361_mg_settle_due_organization_kpi_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_organization_input_status
			var:zg361_mg_organization_input_status = 1
			has_variable = zg361_mg_organization_input_owner
			has_variable = zg361_mg_organization_input_subject
			has_variable = zg361_mg_organization_input_value
			var:zg361_mg_organization_input_owner = liege
			var:zg361_mg_organization_input_subject = this
			has_variable = zg361_mg_organization_input_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_mg_organization_input_due_cycle
			AND = { var:zg361_mg_organization_input_due_cycle >= { value = var:zg361_mg_organization_input_source_cycle add = 1 } var:zg361_mg_organization_input_due_cycle <= { value = var:zg361_mg_organization_input_source_cycle add = 1 } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = zg361_b1_cycle_serial
					var:zg361_b1_cycle_serial >= var:zg361_mg_organization_input_due_cycle
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_variable = zg361_b1_cycle_serial }
					has_variable = zg361_review_serial
					var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_mg_organization_input_source_cycle
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_organization_input_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_organization_settled_by_owner value = liege }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_organization_settled_cycle value = var:zg361_mg_organization_input_due_cycle }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_b1_cycle_serial } set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_organization_settled_cycle value = var:zg361_b1_cycle_serial } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_organization_settled_value value = var:zg361_mg_organization_input_value }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_organization_settlement_receipt value = var:zg361_mg_organization_input_source_case }
	}
}

zg361_mg_apply_due_distribution_policy_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_status
			var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_status = 1
			has_variable = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_owner
			var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_owner = this

			has_variable = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_due_cycle

			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = zg361_b1_cycle_serial
					var:zg361_b1_cycle_serial >= var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_due_cycle
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_variable = zg361_b1_cycle_serial }
					has_variable = zg361_review_serial
					var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_source_cycle
				}
			}
			has_variable = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_mode
			var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_mode >= 1
			var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_mode <= 3
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_effective_mode value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_mode }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_effective_cycle value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_due_cycle }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_effective_source_cycle value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_source_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_effective_source_case value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_source_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_effective_input_revision value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_input_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_applied_this_rank value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_settled_cycle value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_effective_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_settlement_receipt value = var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_source_case }
	}
}

zg361_mg_set_bottom_slots_effect = {

	zg361_mg_apply_due_distribution_policy_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = zg361_bottom_slots value = zg361_bottom_slots_value }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_mg_distribution_policy_applied_this_rank = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_bottom_slots value = zg361_mg_effective_bottom_slots_value }
	}
	remove_variable = zg361_mg_distribution_policy_applied_this_rank
}

zg361_mg_m360_apply_collective_cost_c1_effect = {
	zg361_mg_clear_red_effect = yes
	remove_variable = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result
	set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_ordinal value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_c1_can_apply_trigger = yes
			scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_route = 2
		}
		# Route B has no approved exception and therefore no cost receipt.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 3 }
		debug_log = "ZG361MG: mechanism 360 cohort 1 manager cost is N/A on route B"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_c1_can_apply_trigger = yes
			zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_c1_receipt_is_current_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 2 }
		debug_log = "ZG361MG: mechanism 360 cohort 1 exact manager-cost replay"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_c1_can_apply_trigger = yes
			scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_route = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_owner value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_al_subject value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_al_cycle value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_submission_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_al_case value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_submission_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_id value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_settlement_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_hash value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_settlement_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cohort_id value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_cohort_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_ordinal value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_manager value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_cycle value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_mg_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_case value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_mg_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_snapshot_source_serial value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_mg_snapshot_source_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_snapshot_revision value = var:zg361_mg_team_snapshot_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_cycle value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_b1_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_case value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_b1_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_source_id value = var:zg361_b1_m360_source_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_source_hash value = var:zg361_b1_m360_source_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_route value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_quota value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_quota }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_exception_count value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_exception_count }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cost value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_manager_cost }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id value = { value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_cohort_id multiply = 1000 add = 360 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_hash value = { value = var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id multiply = 100 add = 10 add = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_manager_cost } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_score_before value = var:zg361_mg_manager_score }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_mg_manager_score add = { value = 0 subtract = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_manager_cost } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_score_after value = var:zg361_mg_manager_score }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_score_delta value = { value = 0 subtract = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_manager_cost } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_status value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 1 }
		debug_log = "ZG361MG: mechanism 360 cohort 1 real manager score cost applied"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_status
			var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_status = 1
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id
					AND = { var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id >= { value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_cohort_id multiply = 1000 add = 360 } var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id <= { value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_cohort_id multiply = 1000 add = 360 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_id
					has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cohort_id
					var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_id = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_settlement_id
					var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cohort_id = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_1_cohort_id
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 4 }
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 360 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 4 }
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 360 }
	}
}

		debug_log = "ZG361MG: mechanism 360 cohort 2 exact manager-cost replay"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_c2_can_apply_trigger = yes
			scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_route = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_owner value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_al_subject value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_al_cycle value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_submission_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_al_case value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_submission_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_id value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_settlement_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_hash value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_settlement_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cohort_id value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_cohort_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_ordinal value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_manager value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_cycle value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_mg_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_case value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_mg_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_snapshot_source_serial value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_mg_snapshot_source_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_mg_snapshot_revision value = var:zg361_mg_team_snapshot_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_cycle value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_b1_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_case value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_b1_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_source_id value = var:zg361_b1_m360_source_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_b1_source_hash value = var:zg361_b1_m360_source_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_route value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_quota value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_quota }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_exception_count value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_exception_count }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cost value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_manager_cost }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id value = { value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_cohort_id multiply = 1000 add = 360 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_hash value = { value = var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id multiply = 100 add = 10 add = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_manager_cost } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_score_before value = var:zg361_mg_manager_score }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_mg_manager_score add = { value = 0 subtract = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_manager_cost } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_score_after value = var:zg361_mg_manager_score }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_score_delta value = { value = 0 subtract = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_manager_cost } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_status value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 1 }
		debug_log = "ZG361MG: mechanism 360 cohort 2 real manager score cost applied"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_status
			var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_status = 1
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id
					AND = { var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id >= { value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_cohort_id multiply = 1000 add = 360 } var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_id <= { value = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_cohort_id multiply = 1000 add = 360 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_id
					has_variable = zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cohort_id
					var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_settlement_id = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_settlement_id
					var:zg361_mg_m360_cost_receipt_cohort_id = scope:zg361_we_m360_cost_subject.var:zg361_we_al_external_collective_2_cohort_id
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 4 }
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 360 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 4 }
		zg361_mg_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 360 }
	}
}

zg361_mg_m360_apply_collective_cost_c3_effect = {
	zg361_mg_clear_red_effect = yes
	remove_variable = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result

		limit = {
			zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_c3_can_apply_trigger = yes

		}
		# Route B has no approved exception and therefore no cost receipt.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mg_m360_collective_cost_last_result value = 3 }
